slug_note: UCI canonical slug is misspelled superconductivty+data; superconductivity+data alias resolves to the same dataset page.
source_citation: Hamidieh, K. (2018). Superconductivty Data [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C53P47. Underlying source: NIMS Superconductor Database (http://supercon.nims.go.jp/index_en.html). Introductory work: Hamidieh (2018), Computational Materials Science / arXiv:1803.10260.

train_csv.role: Primary modeling table for NGBoost pilot
train_csv.description: Aggregated chemical/statistical features extracted from superconductor compositions.

unique_m_csv.role: Parallel elemental-composition representation; not merged into pilot features by default
unique_m_csv.element_symbol_columns: H through Rn (86 element fraction columns)
unique_m_csv.description: Chemical formula decomposed into elemental fractions plus material string and critical temperature.

row_alignment.note: UCI states both files cover the same 21263 superconductors; row order aligns on critical_temp.

leakage_controls.pilot_default: Use train.csv only; do not concatenate unique_m element columns with train aggregated features.
leakage_controls.avoid: Joining both representations without deduplication would double-count chemical information and risk misalignment if sorted independently.

raw_format.dtypes_observed: numeric float-parseable in all columns inspected

paper_overlap.note: Superconductivity absent from official regression loader map and paper Tables 1–3.

queries: repo grep under .RnD/source/ngboost for superconductivity paths
prior_application_search.finding: No superconductivity loader or experiment path in pinned official NGBoost repo (grep: no matches). Prior targeted search (2026-08-23) found Tc prediction with other models (e.g. XGBoost) but no documented NGBoost application on this UCI table.
prior_application_search.limitation: Non-exhaustive. Paper-absence and bounded search do not prove global non-use.

compute_feasibility.cpu_assessment: Moderate for full official protocol: 21263 rows × 81 features × 2000 estimators × 3 variants × 20 splits is substantially heavier than Yacht/Kin8nm pilots.
compute_feasibility.proposal_listing_policy: Full dataset (21263 rows, 81 features) may be listed in proposal feasibility section with UCI licence and citation.
compute_feasibility.pilot_scope_recommendation: Predeclare either (A) full train.csv with fewer splits (e.g. 5) for natural/ordinary/homoscedastic comparison, or (B) fixed random subset (e.g. n=5000, seed documented) with paper-aligned 90/10 protocol — authorize in separate pilot handoff; do not assume 20-split full-data timing without evidence.
compute_feasibility.timing_note: No model was run in this audit; estimates are qualitative from dimensionality and prior Yacht/Kin8nm runtimes.

primary_row_level_paper_aligned.approach: Row-level random 90/10 holdouts with np.random.seed(1); 20 repetitions for paper alignment OR fewer repetitions (e.g. 5) if pilot scoped to manage compute; identical split draws across natural, ordinary, homoscedastic variants.
primary_row_level_paper_aligned.preprocessing: Use train.csv header; target=critical_temp; drop exact duplicate rows if lead requires (66 full duplicates observed) or retain with disclosure.
primary_row_level_paper_aligned.scientific_question: Probabilistic Tc regression from aggregated material descriptors; ablation ordering under bounded compute.
primary_row_level_paper_aligned.leakage_risk: Low if train.csv used alone and material identifiers excluded. Do not merge unique_m columns into features.

optional_subset_pilot.approach: Fixed random subset of rows (seed documented) before split generation if full-data pilot exceeds timebox.

preprocessing_recommendation: Primary path: train.csv only. No mandatory feature scaling for tree NGBoost. Exclude material strings from unique_m.csv. Document handling of 66 exact duplicate rows and 2374 aggregated-feature collisions with differing Tc before pilot freeze.

feasibility.ethics_privacy: Public materials-science data from NIMS Superconductor Database via UCI; no personal identifiers.

unresolved_concerns: Compute for full 20-split × 3-variant protocol on 21k×81 may exceed practical pilot timebox without predeclared subset or fewer splits.
6093 duplicate aggregated-feature tuples; 2374 map to multiple Tc values — interpret carefully.
UCI slug/title misspelling (Superconductivty) preserved in authoritative metadata.
